findings.title: Indemnification obligations carved out of liability cap without limitation
findings.deviation: Section 9.2 carves out all indemnification obligations from the aggregate liability cap rather than limiting the exception to third-party IP infringement.
findings.impact: AtliQ could face uncapped liability for general third-party indemnification claims beyond intellectual property infringement.
findings.quote: EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
findings.counterPosition: Limit the liability cap carve-out for indemnification strictly to third-party IP infringement claims.

findings.title: Missing explicit sole and exclusive remedy language for delay penalties
findings.deviation: Section 11.1 caps liquidated damages at 5% of the milestone fee but omits stating that liquidated damages are AtliQ's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
findings.impact: The client might attempt to claim additional damages for project delay beyond the liquidated damages cap.
findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete a milestone by the date specified in the SOW due to causes attributable to Vendor, Lakeshore Grocers may assess liquidated damages of one-half percent (0.5%) of the affected Milestone Fee per week of delay, up to a maximum of five percent (5%) of that Milestone Fee.
findings.counterPosition: Clarify that liquidated damages are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Insurance requirements require verification against active AtliQ coverage
findings.deviation: Section 14.4 requires Commercial General Liability of $1,000,000 and Professional Liability of $2,000,000, which must be verified against AtliQ's unrecorded active policy limits.
findings.impact: AtliQ may commit to insurance requirements that exceed its current coverage limits.
findings.quote: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability ($1,000,000) and professional liability ($2,000,000) insurance.
findings.counterPosition: Confirm AtliQ's existing policy limits match the required levels or adjust the required limits prior to signing.

fine.note: Payment terms of 30 days of receipt of invoice align with AtliQ standard.
IP assignment applies upon full payment for specific deliverables, while AtliQ retains background tools.
Convenience termination requires 30 days notice and payment for all services performed through termination date.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with standard exceptions and 3-year survival.
Non-solicitation restriction is mutual and limited to 12 months for engaged personnel.
Warranty provides standard professional performance and 90-day post-acceptance re-performance remedy.
Indemnity is mutual for third-party bodily injury and property damage caused by negligence.
Data security requirements comply with standard, including 72-hour breach notification.
